entities.summary: Adam Thomas Beyer is a Swedish electronic dance music producer and DJ. Originally starting his musical journey in the techno scene, though over the last decade he has made a gradual shift towards playing more progressive EDM and Trance styles, which have been well received by newer fans at the larger music festivals he is playing.
